screenshots.name: zh-text-1440-top
screenshots.observations: Chinese title, muted printed-page line, serif prose and larger math-style numerals are readable. Visible statements form short two-to-three-sentence groups with clear inter-group gaps and no text collision. The first figure starts below its introductory prose; its Schematic eye heading and upper diagram are visible at the viewport foot. The diagram continues below the viewport through ordinary vertical page scrolling, not horizontal page clipping. Its full caption is outside this screenshot.

screenshots.name: zh-exercises-1440-zero-questions
screenshots.observations: Chinese exercise heading and printed-page line fit cleanly. The visible left-arrow back-to-text button is separated from the heading and has a readable label. The rest of the page is empty, consistent with the reused zero-question DOM contract; no invented questions, answer controls or filler practice appear.

screenshots.name: zh-text-390-top
screenshots.observations: Chinese title fits on one line. Prose and numerals remain readable with visible side margins; sentences wrap naturally and the two-to-three-sentence grouping survives the narrow viewport. Longer groups use more physical lines without becoming a continuous wall of text. No figure or figure caption is visible in this top viewport. The right vertical scrollbar and viewport-bottom continuation are normal page scrolling.

screenshots.name: zh-text-390-final-figure-scroll-end
screenshots.observations: At the final figure's horizontal scroll end, right-side eye outlines, ray endpoints and repeated Retina labels are visible and readable. Explanatory diagram text occupies separate bands between panels and does not collide with the visible drawings. Some panel headings and sentence beginnings are offscreen to the left, and the first heading also meets the viewport top; these are scroll-position boundaries, not a claim that the entire figure is simultaneously visible. The reused 640 px media, 297 px internal range, endReachable and empty page-clipping contracts support intentional internal scrolling. An external figure caption and horizontal-scroll-back action are not shown in this viewport.

screenshots.name: en-text-1440-top
screenshots.observations: The modern English title The Eye and Spectacles and Printed page 199 are displayed without a Chinese title fallback. Serif English prose and embedded numerals are readable; the visible passage uses short paired-sentence groups, clear group spacing and a controlled text column. No words extend outside the column or overlap preceding text. The first diagram and its caption are below this top viewport. Prose continues normally at the bottom.

screenshots.name: en-text-390-top
screenshots.observations: The English modern title fits on one line with clear side margins, and the printed-page line remains secondary. Prose wraps into readable narrow lines; Figure 184, decimal values and numbered terms stay legible. Paired-sentence groups remain separated even when one sentence spans several lines. There is no whole-page horizontal text clipping or overlap. No diagram, external caption or navigation control is visible in this top viewport.

screenshots.name: en-text-390-final-figure-scroll-end
screenshots.observations: The final figure shows the same readable right-side Retina labels and ray/eye detail at its English mobile scroll endpoint. Diagram explanation text and panel drawings are vertically separated. Left-truncated headings, note beginnings and the partial not-to-scale line belong to the intentionally scrolled fixed-width figure; they are not prose-column overflow or leaked build-tool diagnostics. This is not a scientific recheck of the rays. The external caption and horizontal-scroll-back action are outside the observed packet.

screenshots.name: en-exercises-390-zero-questions
screenshots.observations: The English exercise heading wraps intentionally onto a second line and stays inside the viewport without overlap. Printed page 199 remains readable. The left-arrow Back to text button has an English label, fits fully and is clearly separated from the heading. The otherwise empty page matches zero questions; no invented practice, missing-question placeholder controls or Chinese navigation fallback appear.

scope.statement: Exactly eight original viewport screenshots: four bilingual desktop/mobile text tops, two bilingual mobile final-figure scroll endpoints, Chinese desktop zero questions and English mobile zero questions. All eight full text/exercise DOM contracts are reused by exact hash-bound reference. This is not exhaustive full-page tile inspection.

The two exercise back controls are visually inspected and all four back targets are present in reused DOM/native HTML bindings; fresh click navigation is not replayed.
No live application, published card, alternative viewport, theme or production runtime was inspected.
scope.reasonNotBlocking: No defect is observed in the authorized packet; every reused figure contract preserves readable text at 640 px and reachable internal endpoints without whole-page clipping.
